extracted.mesh_code:
real L = 1.0;    // normalized design-domain width
real H = 1.0;    // normalized design-domain height
real lq = 0.2;   // half-length of the heated segment (hot side = central 40%)
border C01(t=0, L/2-lq){x=t; y=0; label=1;}         // bottom edge, adiabatic left
border C02(t=0, 2*lq){x=L/2-lq+t; y=0; label=2;}    // bottom edge, convective heating
border C03(t=0, L/2-lq){x=L/2+lq+t; y=0; label=1;}  // bottom edge, adiabatic right
border C04(t=0, H){x=L; y=t; label=3;}              // right edge, convection
border C05(t=0, L){x=L-t; y=H; label=3;}            // top edge, convection
border C06(t=0, H){x=0; y=H-t; label=3;}            // left edge, convection
int n = 50;
mesh Th = buildmesh(C01(n) + C02(n) + C03(n) + C04(n) + C05(n) + C06(n));
extracted.geometry_description: The design domain is the normalized unit square. Low-temperature exhaust gas sweeps the central forty percent of the bottom edge; the remaining bottom edge is adiabatic. The other three edges exchange heat with ambient air. The initial design is the full solid square with a circular hole of radius 0.1 cut out of its centre.

designed.mesh_code:
real L = 1.0;    // normalized design-domain width
real H = 1.0;    // normalized design-domain height
real lq = 0.2;   // half-length of the heated segment (hot side = central 40%)
border C01(t=0, L/2-lq){x=t; y=0; label=1;}         // bottom edge, adiabatic left
border C02(t=0, 2*lq){x=L/2-lq+t; y=0; label=2;}    // bottom edge, convective heating
border C03(t=0, L/2-lq){x=L/2+lq+t; y=0; label=1;}  // bottom edge, adiabatic right
border C04(t=0, H){x=L; y=t; label=3;}              // right edge, convection
border C05(t=0, L){x=L-t; y=H; label=3;}            // top edge, convection
border C06(t=0, H){x=0; y=H-t; label=3;}            // left edge, convection
int n = 50;
mesh Th = buildmesh(C01(n) + C02(n) + C03(n) + C04(n) + C05(n) + C06(n));
designed.domain_description: Normalized unit square design domain [0,1]x[0,1]. The central 40% of the bottom edge (label 2) is the heated gas-side boundary (Gamma_H, Robin with convection plus radiation); the remaining bottom edge segments (label 1) are adiabatic; the left, top and right edges (label 3) are the cooling boundaries (Gamma_c) exchanging heat with ambient air and are design/free boundaries. The initial circular hole of radius 0.1 at the centre is carved by the level-set function and is therefore not present in the mesh (its boundary is labelled 10 automatically during optimisation).
